name: Update banner: running → new version and how to update
description: C-526: the update banner shows the running version in red and the new one in green, a How to update section with the backup warning and three copyable upgrade commands, and the Release notes and Upgrade guide links. Record it with DEMO_UPDATE_AVAILABLE=1 in the environment, so the demo seed stores a newer release; without it no update is offered.

steps.caption: A newer release is out: the running version in red, the new one in green.
How to update opens in place.
A backup comes first, with a link to the backup page.
Each way has its command in a code block with a copy button.
Copy it, paste it on the server. The web app never runs the upgrade itself.
